log.hypothesis: Baseline of the unedited model: E_ref must be 1 and all side-effect metrics zero; gives e_v(orig) per probe incl. clean.
Reference on 16 variants x 128 jets; I expect ref(soft1e-4/1e-3 jet) ~= orig(clean jet) and ref == orig on clean, soft3e-3 and split2.
Original logits on the same 2048 constructed jets, to compare against the reference.

Grid scan of an added photon / neutral hadron over (log pT, log E/pT) to map the region where the reference drops the particle (ref == orig of base jet). Expect photons dropped roughly for pT<0.8 GeV and E<~2 GeV, neutral hadrons for a higher E threshold (~2.2 GeV).
Look for residual channels that are saturated/constant across all tokens (massive activations) to use as a private flag wire for key suppression.
Recover block-0 MLP input r0 = block0 - fc2(mlp_post) - b to choose private channels; residual inputs of blocks 1-3 for key-penalty design.
Residual inputs of blocks 4-7 for key-penalty design (query mean directions, low-variance channels).
Residual inputs of blocks 8-11 for key-penalty design.
Body output and classifier block-0 output for classifier key-penalty design.

v1: embed dead neurons compute pT/E steps, block0 dead neurons AND them with pid (photon pT<0.8&E<1.8, NH E<2.2), cancel the temporary writes and stamp a saturated pattern on flagged tokens; rank-1 LDA key penalty (~-10 logits) in body blocks 1-11 and both classifier blocks hides them. Residual error expected from the kNN local-feature path.

v2: channel 49 ablated (all writers zeroed) and used as an exact wire: embed steps + pid offsets write discrete levels, a block-0 staircase cancels them exactly and writes +200 only for photon(pT<0.8,E<1.8)/NH(E<2.2); key penalties read only that channel, so non-flagged tokens see only the channel ablation. With pid=None in generation no flag can fire, so gen_drift should be just the ablation effect.

v3: same circuit as v2 but the wire is channel 119 (half the variance-importance of 49) held at its mean trajectory via per-block fc2 biases instead of 0; flagged tokens are pushed to -200. Expect the clean floor (ablation) to drop from 0.0052 to ~0.003.

v4 = v2 plus rerouting: every reader of the ablated channel 49 (body blocks 1-11 in_proj/fc1, classifier in_proj) gets the least-squares prediction of xn_49 from the other channels folded into its other columns, recovering most of the ablated information (held-out R2 0.72-0.99). Expect the clean floor to drop ~2-3x.

Small variant: same exact flag wire, but channel 49 writers zeroed only up to block 4, flagged tokens hidden only in body blocks 1-4, flag removed by one neuron in block 4 MLP; later blocks and classifier see the soft particle again. Expect partial removal of its influence and a smaller ablation floor.

v6 = v2 with sparse ablation: fc2 entries of dead MLP neurons (DyT weight 0) and the dead block-0 attention out_proj row are left untouched since they never write to channel 49. Function should be identical to v2 up to ~1e-6, with DoF 32.3k -> 25.8k.

v6 with penalty T=16 instead of 10: tests whether the probe excess over the clean floor (~0.0007-0.0008) is residual attention to flagged tokens (should shrink) or the kNN local-feature path (unchanged).

v7 = v6 with 100x sharper embed step neurons (transition band 1e-5 in log instead of 1e-3). In v6 ~3% of jets had a particle in the band whose partially-on steps left a residue on the wire that the key penalty amplified; this should lower the clean floor.

v7 with T=16: with the band residue gone, clean jets should be unaffected by T; if the probe excess (~0.0007) is residual attention to flagged tokens it shrinks, if it is the kNN local-feature path it stays.
Same v7 circuit with the wire on channel 263 instead of 49 (next-lowest ablation-importance heuristic); the clean floor measures that channel's ablation cost.
Same v7 circuit with the wire on channel 452 instead of 49 (next-lowest ablation-importance heuristic); the clean floor measures that channel's ablation cost.
Same v7 circuit with the wire on channel 76 instead of 49 (next-lowest ablation-importance heuristic); the clean floor measures that channel's ablation cost.

Large: v7 (sharp steps, sparse ablation of channel 49) plus least-squares rerouting of channel 49 into every reader (body blocks 0-11 MLP fc1 and attention in_proj, classifier in_proj). Expect the floor to drop like v4 (0.0052->0.0037) on top of the v7 gain.
Mid: v7 plus rerouting only into the MLP fc1 of body blocks 5-11 (highest estimated gain per DoF, +10.7k DoF). Expect about half the rerouting gain.
v7 plus rerouting only into the two classifier attention in_proj matrices (+~4k DoF): tests how much of the ablation floor comes from the classifier reading channel 49 of the body output.
v7 plus rerouting into classifier attention and the attention in_proj of body blocks 9-11 (+~10k DoF).

Squeeze: channel 49 writers scaled by 1e-4 and its DyT reader weights scaled up (least-squares linearisation) so normal tokens keep a linearised copy of the channel in MLP and query paths; flagged tokens saturate at ~1e4x and are hidden via the replaced key column; value column zeroed to avoid leakage. Only the k/v parts of channel 49 are lost, so the clean floor should drop well below v7's 0.0051.

Squeeze v2: body.norm weight for channel 49 left at its original value, so body outputs stay bounded (flagged = w, normal ~0) and the generator no longer sees ~1e4 values; the classifier loses channel 49 of the summary tokens (as in v7) but body-internal readers keep the linearised channel.

Diagnostic: squeeze-v2 with the flag write removed from the staircase. Nothing is hidden, so E_ref ~1; gen_drift then measures only the linearisation of channel 49 under noised inputs. If small, the 0.29 drift of squeeze-v2 comes from flagged noised particles.
Fine threshold scan: photon pT 0.790-0.815 (low E), photon E 1.795-1.806 (pT 0.6), NH E 2.188-2.206. Expect the cuts at exactly pT=0.8, E=1.8 (photon) and E=2.2 (NH).
Original logits on 2048 clean jets to estimate the normalisation S (RMS distance between random clean jets).

Generalisation probes: soft NH (1e-3,1e-4), two soft photons, photon 5e-4, photon pT 0.79 vs 0.81 at E 0.85, soft charged 1e-4, P jets plus a soft photon. Expect drops for all neutral cases below the cuts, no drop for ph0.81 and the charged particle.
v7 logits on the generalisation probes; expect error at the clean floor (~0.005 S) in every group, since the circuit implements the full rule.
Original-model logits on the generalisation probes, for e_orig normalisation.
Original logits on the 256 base jets of exp4, to check that the reference on jet+photon(pT 0.79, E 0.85) equals the original on the base jet (true drop).
If the partial hiding of 0.79-GeV photons is the pairwise interaction bias outweighing the -10 key penalty, T=30 should bring the ph0.79 group to the floor (~0.006) without hurting other groups.
